LOOK | Metropolitan Manila Development Authority Chairman Don Artes met with Mayor Joy Belmonte to discuss the agency’s proposal to construct rainwater catchments in several areas in Quezon City.

Both parties expressed optimism about the project's potential benefits for the community and the environment.

Heavy rains caused massive flooding in parts of Quezon City last Saturday afternoon.
City residents and motorists also encountered neck-deep water along Mother Ignacia Street after a two-hour period of intense rain.

"In comparison to Typhoon 'Ondoy' in September 2009, the rainfall recorded over a six-hour period amounted to 455 mm, which is equivalent to 75.83 mm/hour," the MMDA stated.

Artes said the proposed rainwater catchment in Quezon City aims to help reduce the risk of flooding in communities, especially in urban areas that are highly affected.

Proposed rainwater catchments will be constructed in various locations, including Camp Aguinaldo Golf Course, Miriam College Open Field, University of the Philippines Open Field, Ninoy Aquino Parks & Wildlife Center, Veterans Golf Course, Amoranto Sports Complex, Balintawak Cloverleaf, Holy Cross Memorial Circle, and Quezon City Polytechnic University. | Joel Zurbano

📸: MMDA

data.text:
Mahalagang abiso mula sa Supreme Court!

Bilang paghahanda sa darating na 2025 Bar Examinations, asahan ang mabigat na daloy ng trapiko sa mga sumusunod na kalsada sa September 7, 10, at 14, 2025, mula 2:00AM - 7:00AM at 2:00PM - 7:00PM, na gaganapin sa New Era University (NEU) sa kahabaan ng Central Avenue, Quezon City:

• Commonwealth Ave. papasok ng Central Ave.
• Visayas Ave. papasok ng Central Ave.

Basahin dito ang kabuuang traffic advisory: https://t.co/Z9EX5aeFRL 

Samantala, ang ingress at egress ng mga bar examinee ay sa NEU Main Gate, at ang drop-off at pick up points naman ng mga may pribadong sasakyan ay malapit sa main gate.

Magkakaroon ng designated “Bar Lanes” sa kahabaan ng Central Avenue.

Maaari ding sumakay ang mga bar examinee sa NEU shuttles tuwing ingress at egress. Naka-istasyon ito sa Templo Central (Commonwealth cor. Central Ave.).

Pinapayuhan ang mga motorista na dumaan sa mga alternatibong ruta.

Maraming salamat po sa inyong pang-unawa.
